title: WebAuthn Relying-Party Implementation Plan
description: A structured plan for a WebAuthn/passkey relying-party implementation -- ceremony, library, verification steps, option choices -- so this skill's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/webauthn_passkey_implementation_audit.mjs.

library.description: The verification library. hand-rolled means DIY CBOR/COSE/attestation parsing, which is rejected.

challengeSource.description: Who generates the ceremony challenge. Must be server.

challengeSingleUse.description: True if the challenge is deleted from the session after one verification attempt.

verifiesChallengeMatch.description: True if clientDataJSON.challenge is compared to the session-stored challenge.

verifiesOrigin.description: True if clientDataJSON.origin is checked against a finite expected-origin allowlist.

verifiesRpIdHash.description: True if authData.rpIdHash is compared to SHA-256(rpId).

verifiesSignature.description: True if the assertion signature is verified over authenticatorData || SHA-256(clientDataJSON) with the stored public key.

counterCheckImplemented.description: True if signCount monotonicity is enforced (strictly greater when either value is > 0) and persisted.

userIdKind.description: How user.id is generated. Must be random-opaque (16-64 bytes, no PII).

userVerification.description: The userVerification option sent in ceremony options.

attestation.description: The attestation conveyance preference. 'none' unless a concrete compliance need exists.

attestationComplianceNeed.description: True if a concrete hardware-policy/compliance requirement justifies attestation stronger than 'none'.

conditionalUiEnabled.description: True if passkey autofill (mediation: 'conditional') is part of this plan.

allowCredentialsEmptyForConditional.description: True if the conditional-UI request sends allowCredentials: [] so any discoverable credential is offered.

excludeCredentialsPopulated.description: True if registration passes the user's existing credentialIds in excludeCredentials.

storesBackupFlags.description: True if deviceType/backedUp (from the BE/BS flags) are persisted per credential.
